title: Expire all user passwords
when: The step asks to force every user in the org to choose a new password at next login, from the 'Expire All Passwords' page, typically after a security incident. It is not resetting one user's password and not changing the password policy.
steps: In the embedded Expire All Passwords page, tick 'Expire all user passwords'.
doneWhen: The page confirms that all user passwords were expired.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 3 actions, 23 s, run with --allow-destructive. Ended by the Setup Audit Trail: Salesforce recorded 'Expired all user passwords', Jev p=0.95. After Save the embedded page goes away, so the loop reopened it; the page itself keeps no sign of the expiry, and the trail is the only proof.

notes: Disruptive for every user, so it is marked destructive and needs --allow-destructive. Trial it last on an org: it may force that org's own user through a password change at the next sign-in.

trial.step: Security incident - expire all user passwords now.
